أَزْلٌ Straitness; distress; difficulty; (S,* K;) and drought, or want of rain. (TA.) ―
-b2- Vehemence of might, or of strength, in war, or fight; of courage, valour, or prowess: or of war, or fight: or of fear: or of punishment: syn. شِدَّةُ بَأْسٍ. (TA.) ＝
-A2- It is also used as an epithet, meaning Strait; narrow; confined. (Ham p. 339.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
